decisions.reason: The source adds tone and colour-palette criteria to the suitability review but does not change whether chapter illustrations are included, how they are referenced, or which supplied image is assigned to the GiftingRight chapter.
The image-suitability criteria do not affect the requirement to exclude unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
Reviewing illustrations for alignment with the book's tone and colour palette does not modify the manuscript copyediting passages or editorial requirements.
The illustration-suitability review does not change the paperback publication format or its layout scope.
